cards.name: Singer of Swift Rivers
cards.oracleText:
Flash
When this creature enters, put a shield counter on another target creature you control. (If it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.)
You may cast Merfolk spells as though they had flash.

cards.name: Singe
cards.oracleText: Singe deals 1 damage to target creature. That creature becomes black until end of turn.

cards.name: Single Combat
cards.oracleText: Each player chooses a creature or planeswalker they control, then sacrifices the rest. Players can't cast creature or planeswalker spells until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Explosive Singularity
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of untapped creatures you control. This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature tapped this way.
Explosive Singularity deals 10 damage to any target.

cards.name: Singing Bell Strike
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
Enchanted creature has "{6}: Untap this creature."

cards.name: Singe-Mind Ogre
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, target player reveals a card at random from their hand, then loses life equal to that card's mana value.

cards.name: Singing Towers of Darillium
cards.oracleText:
Each nonland card in your hand without foretell has foretell. Its foretell cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {2}. (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile it from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
Whenever chaos ensues, you may cast a foretold card you own from exile without paying its mana cost this turn.

cards.name: Singularity Rupture
cards.oracleText: Destroy all creatures, then any number of target players each mill half their library, rounded down.

cards.name: Singing Tree
cards.oracleText: {T}: Target attacking creature has base power 0 until end of turn.
